goal: Survey-first skincare routine recommender with evidence grades, shown as an MVP demo.

decisions.recommendation: Rules over curated data decide products; AI only explains them
decisions.signup: After the survey; real Google login (own OAuth + signed cookie, no DB) now; saved routines in a database later
decisions.styling: Tailwind CSS v4; design tokens in design/tokens.json generate the @theme block
decisions.newsletter: Mock only: validates and confirms, stores and sends nothing

milestones.name: Result page with evidence badges, AD labels, consent
Mobile landing page with animation, Login and Try-out buttons
Google login (code flow + PKCE, signed session cookie)
Set Google OAuth credentials on Railway and test real sign-in
Real product and evidence data with citations
Save routines to the account (Railway Postgres)
Coupang Partners / Naver adapter behind a retailer interface

risks: Sample data must be replaced with cited evidence before launch
Ingredient-level evidence must not be presented as product-level
Survey answers are sensitive; overseas AI transfer needs explicit consent and legal review
Affiliate income must not influence evidence grades
Google login cannot be verified end to end until real OAuth credentials are configured
